description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and three accuracy metrics—final accuracy, change in accuracy (Δ Accuracy), and initial accuracy—for LLMs under feedback friction. The x-axis represents “Initial Confidence,” ranging from 0.91 to 0.99 with tick labels at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis represents “Accuracy,” scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0. The blue line with circular markers and solid style represents “Final Accuracy,” starting at approximately 0.85, peaking near 0.92 at an initial confidence of 0.93, then declining slightly to around 0.87 by 0.99. The orange line with diamond markers and dashed style represents “Δ Accuracy,” beginning at approximately 0.55, peaking near 0.65 at an initial confidence of 0.92, then generally declining to about 0.15 by an initial confidence of 0.99. The green line with square markers and dashed style represents “Initial Accuracy,” starting at approximately 0.35, rising to a peak of about 0.85 at an initial confidence of 0.98, then declining slightly to around 0.78 by 0.99. All lines are accompanied by error bars indicating variability.
